model.title: MORE WATER Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Alex Padilla (D-CA)

summary.text: The bill would extend and reauthorize a federal program that supports large-scale water recycling and reuse projects. It would also establish a new program to improve water conveyance systems, helping communities better manage and distribute water resources.
